abstract.p: A synthetic production note for comparing the print, web, and structured outputs from one accepted manuscript.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: An editorial handoff is easier to review when the production files share the same accepted text. This demonstration follows one synthetic manuscript through print, web, and structured XML.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We prepared a short accepted manuscript with section headings and a metadata record. The same source was used to generate an HTML galley, a two-column PDF, and JATS Publishing XML. We checked the article title and compared the section order across the three outputs.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: The print galley presents a two-column layout. The HTML version preserves headings for reading on the web. The XML records the journal and article metadata in structured elements and separates the front matter from the body.

sec.title: Conclusion
sec.p: A repeatable conversion step gives a production editor a consistent starting point for proofreading and registering each galley in OJS.
